title: Figure 9: Lightcraft vehicle evolution in three steps (shapes and drag-vs-angle plot)
description: Upper drawings show three Lightcraft vehicle outlines labeled (1) "Takeoff Mass = 4.0 kg, Frontal Area = 0.78 m²" and (2)/(3) "Takeoff Mass = 8.0 kg, Frontal Area = .096 m²". Below, a log-scale plot of transonic drag area per unit mass against half-apex angle of forebody (degrees) traces a dashed curve through vehicle shapes with CdA/W values .0026, .0054 and .1658, marking the "SDIO Lightcraft" and a "Range for Currently Envisioned Scramjets". Caption: "Figure 9. Lightcraft Vehicle Evolution (in 3 steps) [26]."
